name: Pacific Airport Group
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-17, accession 0001193125-26-161714): the registered NYSE security is American Depositary Shares 'each representing 10 Series B shares' (20-F cover / Description of Securities), and the EPS disclosure states 'Earnings per ADS are based on a ratio of 10 Series B shares per ADS'
ads_ratio.reason: 20-F filer: EDGAR per-share figures are per ordinary (Series B) share while the traded PAC price is per ADS; per-share figures must be scaled x10 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (filed 2025-04-24, accession 0000950170-25-057571), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities: 'Purchases of machinery, equipment, improvements on leased assets, improvements to concession assets and advance payments to suppliers' Ps.8,431,106 thousand for FY2022, Ps.10,444,346 thousand for FY2023 and Ps.7,844,983 thousand for FY2024 (in thousands of Mexican pesos); the same line in the FY2025 20-F (filed 2026-04-17) is Ps.10,444,346 thousand FY2023 / Ps.7,844,983 thousand FY2024 / Ps.12,396,949 thousand FY2025, confirming the series
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for fiscal years 2022, 2023, 2024 of the last 3 under every tag the engine reads: EDGAR companyfacts for this IFRS filer carries no PurchaseOfPropertyPlantAndEquipment (or any capex) concept at all, because the filer's capex is concession-asset investment reported on this single combined cash-flow line. The engine applies one override value to every missing period; Ps.10,444,346,000 is the filed FY2023 figure, and FY2023 is the median year of the 3-year normalized base once capex is charged at filed values (filed-basis OE/share: FY2022 $0.4113, FY2023 $0.4077, FY2024 $0.8425 per ordinary share), so the scored base is built from the exact filed figure for its year. The single value overstates FY2024 capex (filed Ps.7,845m) and understates nothing in the base year; FY2025's filed Ps.12,397m shows the MDP capex cycle is rising, not falling, so the override is not flattering the forward picture. Declared in MXN, the reporting currency; the engine FX-converts at each period-end rate.

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-17, accession 0001193125-26-161714), Item 16G NYSE-standards comparison, Equity Compensation Plans: 'No equity-compensation plans have been approved by our shareholders'; Note 22 Employee Cost for 2023, 2024 and 2025 is comprised solely of wages and salaries, other remunerations, social benefits, severance payments, labor union fees, taxes on employee benefits, PTU and retirement benefits — no share-based line; the term 'share-based' appears nowhere in the 20-F, and EDGAR companyfacts carries no ifrs-full AdjustmentsForSharebasedPayments fact for this filer in any year
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2022, 2023, 2024 of the last 3 under every tag the engine reads. GAP has no equity-settled share-based payment expense to subtract: no equity compensation plans exist, employee cost is all cash compensation (already inside operating cash flow), and there is no IFRS 2 expense in the filing. The filing-sourced figure for equity SBC in the gap years is Ps.0 (same treatment as TS, SQM, KEP and LTM in this sweep).

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-17, accession 0001193125-26-161714), EPS disclosure: weighted average common shares outstanding (excluding treasury shares) of 519,372,684 (FY2021), 508,371,309 (FY2022), 505,277,464 (FY2023), 505,277,464 (FY2024) and 505,277,464 (FY2025), reflecting the repurchase program; accounting policy note r: 'The Company does not have any potentially diluted shares; and therefore, basic and diluted earnings per share are the same' (also in the FY2024 20-F). Cross-check from companyfacts: FY2024 profit attributable to owners Ps.8,612,157 thousand / filed diluted EPS Ps.17.0444 = 505.28 million shares
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — DILUTED shares missing for fiscal years 2022, 2023, 2024 of the last 3; the only filed count is ifrs-full WeightedAverageShares, a basic tag, and companyfacts carries it scaled 1,000x (505,277,464,000) because the filing presents share counts alongside statements in thousands — the same share-basis defect family as NTNX/VIV/DD in this sweep. The filer's own EPS note states basic and diluted are the same (no potentially dilutive shares), so the basic count IS the diluted count. The engine applies this single FY2023-25 value to every missing period; for FY2022 it uses a 0.6% smaller denominator than the filer's own 508,371,309 (immaterial, disclosed), and it is exact for FY2023 and FY2024, two of the three base years.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 22 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency MXN converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x10.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-17, accession 0001193125-26-161714): the registered NYSE security is American Depositary Shares 'each representing 10 Series B shares' (20-F cover / Description of Securities), and the EPS disclosure states 'Earnings per ADS are based on a ratio of 10 Series B shares per ADS') so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
